description: Register a ConfluenceResource wrapping the Confluence Cloud REST v2 API (pages/spaces) for use by other components

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

site_domain.label: Site Domain
site_domain.description: Your Atlassian site subdomain (for yoursite.atlassian.net, pass 'yoursite').

email_env_var.label: Email Env Var
email_env_var.description: Env var holding the Atlassian account email (Basic auth username).

api_token_env_var.label: Api Token Env Var
api_token_env_var.description: Env var holding an Atlassian API token.

name: Confluence Resource
